4681-5170-8175-8249.description:
Activate Defiant Salvager by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
When Karmic Guide dies, Edgar triggers, causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Defiant Salvager ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Defiant Salvager
Activate Defiant Salvager by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Edgar trigger.
Resolve the Edgar trigger, causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Karmic Guide enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Defiant Salvager ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Defiant Salvager
Repeat.

1432-2645-3430-5233.easyPrerequisites: Ioreth of the Healing House doesn't have summoning sickness.
1432-2645-3430-5233.description:
Activate Boros Garrison by tapping it, adding {R}{R}{R}{W}{W}{W} due to Nyxbloom Ancient
Activate Ioreth of the Healing House by tapping it, untapping Boros Garrison
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Ioreth of the Healing House.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.

969-3755-4770-6090.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying its mana cost.
When Whitemane Lion enters, it and Arahbo trigger.
Resolve the Arahbo trigger, creating a 1/1 Cat creature token.
Holding priority, activate Whitemane Lion and the Cat token by tapping them, adding {1}{W}.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

475-1274-1379-4186.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
475-1274-1379-4186.description:
Gain life in any way.
Heliod triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token that enters the battlefield as an artifact due to Encroaching Mycosynth.
Leonin Elder triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

273-586-7070.description:
Activate Shuko's equip ability by paying {0}, targeting Priest of Gix.
Monk Gyatso triggers, airbending Priest of Gix.
The Shuko ability fizzles due to no longer having a legal target.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying {2}.
When Priest of Gix enters, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

1283-1978-4324.description:
Animate Chromatic Orrery using Workshop Elders.
Activate Chromatic Orrery by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}{C}
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Chromatic Orrery.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and with three or more charge counters on it

1978-2593-3488.description:
Animate Astral Cornucopia using Katsumasa.
Activate Astral Cornucopia by tapping it, adding at least three mana of any color
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Astral Cornucopia.
Repeat from step 2.

2558-4186-6701-6797.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Sword of the Meek
When you sacrifice Sword of the Meek, Szarel triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
When the Squirrel enters the battlefield, Sword of the Meek triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the Squirrel.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat.
2558-4186-6701-6797.notes: The combo puts infinite +1/+1 counters on each creature you control except Szarel.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and cannot be blocked and killed by an opponent

803-3073-3951-5703.description:
Declare Altaïr as an attacker, triggering its ability twice.
Resolve a Altaïr trigger, exiling Éomer from your graveyard with a memory counter on it and creating a tapped and attacking copy of Éomer.
Resolve the other Altaïr trigger, creating a tapped and attacking copy of Éomer.
Put either Éomer token into your graveyard due to the legend rule, triggering the other Éomer token, causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
At the end of your combat phase, Altaïr triggers, causing you to exile the Éomer token.
Repeat each combat phase.

628-1228-5571-6331.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to give Goblin Sharpshooter deathtouch.
You control an additional nontoken non-Human creature that does not have indestructible or protection from red.
628-1228-5571-6331.description:
Give control of Blightbeetle to an opponent, if needed. Also, give Goblin Sharpshooter deathtouch, if needed.
Activate Goblin Sharpshooter by tapping it, dealing 1 damage to the additional creature and destroying it due to Goblin Sharpshooter's deathtouch.
When the creature dies, its undying ability and Goblin Sharpshooter trigger.
Resolve the creature's undying trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to Blightbeetle.
Resolve the Goblin Sharpshooter trigger, untapping it.
Repeat from step 2.

232-1363-1636.easyPrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature,
232-1363-1636.description:
Cast Priest of Urabrask by paying {2}{R}.
When Priest of Urabrask enters the battlefield, it and Intruder Alarm trigger.
Resolve the Priest of Urabrask trigger, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Resolve the Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
Activate Tradewind Rider by tapping it, Priest of Urabrask and one other creature you control, returning Priest of Urabrask from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
232-1363-1636.notes: If you control creature(s) that can tap to produce mana, you can use that mana to pay for the creature and instead gain mana from the creature's ETB ability.

2173-4423-4482-4693-6491.manaNeeded: {G} if Enter the Unknown is in your hand
2173-4423-4482-4693-6491.easyPrerequisites: If Enter the Unknown is on top of your library, your life total must be at least 2.
2173-4423-4482-4693-6491.notablePrerequisites: You control three or more Islands.
2173-4423-4482-4693-6491.description:
Cast Enter the Unknown either from your hand by paying {G} or from the top of your library by paying 1 life, causing a creature you control to explore and allowing you to play an additional land this turn.
Play Mystic Sanctuary either from your hand or graveyard.
When Mystic Sanctuary enters the battlefield untapped, it triggers twice, putting Enter the Unknown from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Activate Mystic Sanctuary by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Overgrown Estate by sacrificing Mystic Sanctuary, causing you to gain 3 life.
Repeat.

uses.n: Jetfire, Ingenious Scientist // Jetfire, Air Guardian

114-855-1283.easyPrerequisites: Jetfire has no +1/+1 counters on it.
114-855-1283.description:
Activate Jetfire, Air Guardian by paying {3}, converting it and putting six +1/+1 counters on it.
Activate Jetfire, Ingenious Scientist by removing all +1/+1 counters from it, adding {6} and converting Jetfire.
Repeat.

1414-4772-6232.description:
Cast Tamiyo by paying {3}{U}{U}. Tamiyo enters the battlefield with eight loyalty counters on it due to Doubling Season.
Activate Tamiyo's third loyalty ability by removing eight loyalty counters from it, causing you to get its emblem.
Cast Lotus Petal by paying {0}.
Activate Lotus Petal by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Tamiyo's emblem triggers, returning Lotus Petal from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat from step 3.

4067-4094-5742-5743.notablePrerequisites: Kaya has at least two loyalty counters on it.
4067-4094-5742-5743.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding Gilded Assault Cart.
Mary Read and Anne Bonny triggers, creating two tapped Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Mind Over Matter ability.
Activate Gilded Assault Cart by sacrificing two Treasures, returning Gilded Assault Cart from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat from step 2.

1385-2452-3249-5670--56.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
1385-2452-3249-5670--56.description:
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast a Zombie from your graveyard this turn.
Cast the Zombie from your graveyard by paying {0} due to Rooftop Storm.
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing the Zombie.
When the Zombie dies, Zulaport Cutthroat triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

uses.n: Ojer Taq, Deepest Foundation // Temple of Civilization

1270-1339-5349.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four tokens.
1270-1339-5349.description:
Activate Izoni by sacrificing four tokens, causing you to surveil 2, draw two cards, and gain 2 life.
The Locust God triggers twice, creating six 1/1 Insect creature tokens with haste.
Repeat.

2097-3750-3809.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill Goldspan Dragon.
2097-3750-3809.description:
Declare Goldspan Dragon as an attacker.
Goldspan Dragon and Jolene trigger, creating four Treasure tokens.
Move to your postcombat main phase.
Activate three Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {4}{R}{R}.
Activate Aggravated Assault by paying {3}{R}{R}, causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat and main phase after this one.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite Treasure tokens, you may use them to activate Jolene's ability to put infinite +1/+1 counters on Jolene.

1133-1703-3518-5112.description:
During your upkeep, activate Mairsil by sacrificing it and discarding your hand, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Mairsil dies, triggering Fool's Demise's first and second abilities.
Resolve the first Fool's Demise trigger, returning Mairsil from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Mairsil using Hakim's first ability by paying {U}{U}, returning Fool's Demise from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Mairsil.
Repeat.

2744-2808-4284.description:
Cast Clone by paying {3}{U}, choosing to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Enduring Scalelord.
Clone enters the battlefield, triggering Cathars' Crusade, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Enduring Scalelord and Clone triggers.
Resolve the Clone trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Enduring Scalelord triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Repeat from step 4.

500-1308-2743.description:
Cast Saw in Half by paying {2}{B}, destroying Biovisionary and creating four token copies of it with base power equal to half the destroyed creature's power and base toughness equal to half the destroyed creature's toughness, rounding up each time.
End your turn.
All the Biovisionaries trigger.
Resolve the first Biovisionary trigger, winning the game.

539-1247-2203.notablePrerequisites: Pili-Pala does not have summoning sickness.
539-1247-2203.description:
Activate Pili-Pala by tapping it, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Pili-Pala by paying {2} and untapping it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat.

79-2713-4013.description:
Activate Eldrazi Displacer by paying {C}, blinking Birthing Hulk.
Birthing Hulk enters the battlefield, creating two 1/1 Eldrazi Scion creature tokens.
Activate an Eldrazi Scion by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.
